analysis_check_function_length_python.natural_decomposition: The current function does three logical things: (1) regex-scan for def/async def starts producing (name, line_idx, indent) tuples ~10 lines, (2) for each start, walk forward tracking indent to compute body length ~12-15 lines, (3) build violation strings ~5-8 lines. Splitting (1) into parse_python_function_starts and (2) into compute_python_func_length leaves the core to (3) plus orchestration: ~15-20 lines. All three pieces fit comfortably under 30 lines.

analysis_other_functions.main (39): extract collect_violations(content, ext) -> list[str], emit_violations(file_path, violations) -> None, decide_grandfather(pre, post) -> tuple[bool, str]; main becomes pure orchestration ~22 lines.
